in_hebrew.name: פגייה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Peggie is derived from the Hebrew word 'pega', which means 'fleet' or 'multitude'. In the Bible, this name is not found in its original form but may be related to the Hebrew word 'pega'am' (multitude).

in_greek.name: Πεγγιέ
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Peggie in Greek is derived from the Greek word 'pengios', which means 'noble' or 'honorable'. However, there is no direct biblical reference to this name in the Greek scripture.

in_latin.name: Peggia
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Peggie in Latin is derived from the Latin word 'peggia', which means 'little pearl'. This name is not directly mentioned in the Bible but may have been used in Christian tradition or literature.
